title: Satisfaction of a binary linear equation
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, let $E$ be a linear equation over $ br/2 br$ with constant term $c$, and let $x:V\to\bbr/2\bbr$ be an assignment. The assignment satisfies $E$ exactly when the sum of each coefficient times its assigned value equals $c$ in $ br/2\bbr$.
